name: DeepSearchQA
subtitle: 多步骤、综合性网页研究任务评测
version: Google DeepSearchQA 技术报告与公开数据/榜单；模型报告所用pass和judge设置未必相同

officialDefinition.summary: 用多步网页研究问题评估智能体检索并综合充分答案的能力。
officialDefinition.task: 智能体针对问题开展多步网页研究，找出多个必要事实并组织覆盖要求的回答。

taskContract.input: 需要综合多项证据的研究问题。
taskContract.output: 含必要答案要点及依据的综合回答。
taskContract.environment: 官方技术报告定义的深度研究任务；榜单、裁判、pass设置与生成模型执行配置需分别核实。

dataProfile.summary: Google DeepMind 报告由900个人工构建问题组成，覆盖17个领域；数据从官方评测页链接至 Kaggle，访问条款和数据许可仍待核实。
scale: 官方技术报告称900个问题，覆盖17个领域

requirements: Kaggle account and dataset terms have not been independently confirmed; no additional gate is inferred.

reusePolicy.license: Google DeepSearchQA Hugging Face 数据卡声明 Apache-2.0；本样例只取该行文本字段。
reusePolicy.scope: 仅覆盖数据卡所声明的 DeepSearchQA 数据行；本记录涉及的外部网页来源不由此许可覆盖。
boundaries: 不得将数据许可扩展到题目引用的第三方网页、外部来源或在线检索结果。
复现实验需另固定搜索工具、可访问网页范围和答案判分设置。

sampleAccess.reason: 已取得此评测的真实记录、原始字段或官方具体案例，并附简短解析；完整环境及省略范围见案例。

metric.name: F1（集合式答案）；另报分项状态指标
metric.description: Google DeepMind报告以F1评价集合式答案，并另列答案状态分布；不得把状态分类指标混称为主准确率。

limitations.text: 多步骤研究结果受搜索索引、可访问网页、检索过程和答案评分器影响。
模型发布文案中笼统引用DeepSearchQA，不能推定其严格复现了官方默认配置。

raw.problem: Consider the OECD countries whose total population was composed of at least 20% of foreign-born populations as of 2023 (according to the Observatory of Migration at the university of Oxford). Amongst them, which country saw their overall criminality score increase by at least +0.2 point between 2021 and 2023 and their resilience score decrease by more than 0.3 between these same dates (according to the Organised Crime Index)?

samples.prompt: Consider the OECD countries whose total population was composed of at least 20% of foreign-born populations as of 2023 (according to the Observatory of Migration at the university of Oxford). Amongst them, which country saw their overall criminality score increase by at least +0.2 point between 2021 and 2023 and their resilience score decrease by more than 0.3 between these same dates (according to the Organised Crime Index)?
samples.explanation: Google DeepMind官方DeepSearchQA eval首行：要求筛选2023年外来人口比例至少20%的OECD国家，再按2021至2023有组织犯罪指数变化筛出 criminality 上升至少0.2且resilience下降超过0.3的国家。该行答案为New Zealand；样例不包括网络搜索轨迹。
samples.title: DeepSearchQA 多步国家指标检索题
